| URL | What it establishes |

| https://www.cms.gov/medicare/enrollment-renewal/providers-suppliers/chain-ownership-system-pecos/manage-your-enrollment | **Medicare enrollment:** PECOS is CMS’s system for providers and suppliers to submit, renew, and update Medicare enrollment information.[web:11] |
| https://proview.caqh.org/PR/Registration/Help | **Provider data and credentialing:** The CAQH Provider Data Portal collects provider-supplied information for authorized organizations; participating organizations perform primary-source verification and make their own credentialing decisions.[web:24] |
| https://www.ncqa.org/programs/health-plans/credentialing/benefits-support/standards/ | **Credentialing:** NCQA describes full-scope credentialing as including credential verification and committee review, not merely storing provider documents.[web:1] |
| https://wpcdn.ncqa.org/www-prod/NCQA-Credentialing-eBook-2023-WEB.pdf | **Delegation:** NCQA says an organization that delegates credentialing activities remains responsible for oversight and should define responsibilities in a signed, dated agreement.[web:70] |
| https://www.jointcommission.org/en/knowledge-library/support-center/standards-interpretation/standards-faqs/000002124 | **Privileging:** The Joint Commission treats granting clinical privileges to provide specified care as a medical-staff requirement distinct from credentialing.[web:61] |
| https://www.certifyos.com/products/credentialing | **Vendor scope:** Certify describes a credentialing product for managing documents, verification, monitoring, and credentialing workflows.[web:46] |
| https://www.medallion.co/solutions/provider-enrollment | **Vendor scope and distinction:** Medallion distinguishes verification of qualifications (**credentialing**) from addition to a payer roster for in-network billing (**enrollment**) and describes its own enrollment offering.[web:31] |

These links support conceptual scope for ClinicianFile, not a claim that ClinicianFile has access to, integrates with, or can automate any third-party system. This is source research, not legal or medical advice.
